snippet.title: There Are No Ghosts At The Grand - Official Game Overview Trailer | gamescom 2026
snippet.description: Get a look at the Game Overview Trailer for There Are No Ghosts At The Grand, an upcoming music-based Lovecraftian restoration simulation game developed by Friday Sundae. Players can get the general overview of the game by way of embodying a decorator by day and a true ghost hunter by night with a sprawling narrative. There Are No Ghosts At The Grand is launching into Early Access in December 2026 for PC (Xbox on PC and Steam) with an eventual release on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam).
